sermon.title: Peoples Who Heard John the Baptist’s Message and Their Reaction — March 7, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer examines who heard John the Baptist and how they reacted. Many repented and were baptized; religious leaders chose religion over repentance; Herod feared John yet killed him. Jesus is the root that makes fruit possible. The fruit of repentance shows in how we treat others, and God calls His people to holiness.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: Can a stump grow back?
faqs.answer: Yes. If the root is right, a stump can grow back and become a fruitful tree.

faqs.question: Does Jesus need to be defended?
faqs.answer: No. He is very capable of defending Himself, and His word is powerful.

scriptures.text_nkjv: that if you confess with your mouth the Lord Jesus and believe in your heart that God has raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.
